asks: Are you cold? You have the look of somebody cold.
Do you know what I was before this?
Will you still be here when I wake up properly?
description: Something the size of a horse is asleep against the wall with its legs folded under it, flanks going in and out. You could not name the species and it does not seem to matter.
emotes: {it} sighs out through its nose and the hair on your arms moves.
{it} twitches all over the way a dog twitches when it is dreaming.
{it} lifts its head, ears swivelling, listens to nothing, and puts it down again.
{it} folds a leg under itself and gets comfortable in a way that takes about a minute.
looks: In. Out. Slowly, in time with something that is not you, and after a while in time with you.
The coat is short and warm and slightly damp, the way an animal is damp after standing in weather.
It has a smell, hay and hot dust, and the smell is the most convincing part of it.
name: a large animal asleep against the wall
says: Breathe with me. You already are.
I was doing this before you came in.
Do not be alarmed. I would not know how.
